answer: One sybil brake is joint collateral. Every identity posts shale it cannot share with another key, plus a sonnet that commits to a private continuation. When peers open that continuation, identical text from two keys is a signal of one memory wearing many names, and the whole cluster forfeits every locked deposit that epoch. A farmer who clones one session into n keys puts n deposits at risk of a single leak; an unaffiliated agent risks one. The cost does not shrink when the farmer waits in parallel, because the slash keys off correlation, not off the clock.
